mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a pleasant 73 degrees with clear skies at Verona Area High School. We have a first quarter moon out tonight, though there are no visible ISS passes to watch for this evening.

For city updates, check out VHAT, your local channel for government meetings and community news. Also, a quick reminder from city hall regarding parking: make sure your recreational vehicles and trailers are parked in approved, dedicated spaces, as they are not allowed to be used for permanent living quarters.

There is plenty to do this week in Verona, including Hop Haus Trivia on Tuesday, the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market on Wednesday at Hometown Junction Park, and Concerts in the Park this Thursday at Century School Park.
On July 15, Verona Police were dispatched to a domestic disturbance on Prairie Oaks Drive, which resulted in an arrest for felony bail jumping.

Today is a great day for a scoop of Chocolate Caramel Twist. Please note that the restaurant is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you starting at 10 AM, and you can look forward to a Mint Explosion flavor tomorrow.
